actions.name: deployed Mamba ransomware
actions.description: Mamba ransomware has been deployed against local governments, public transportation agencies, legal services, technology services, industrial, commercial, manufacturing, and construction businesses.

actions.name: weaponized DiskCryptor to encrypt entire drive including operating system
actions.description: Mamba ransomware weaponizes DiskCryptor—an open source full disk encryption software— to restrict victim access by encrypting an entire drive, including the operating system.

actions.name: passed encryption key via command-line parameter
actions.description: The attacker passes the encryption key via the command-line parameter: [Ransomware Filename].exe <password>.

actions.name: installed encryption service and started disk encryption
actions.description: The ransomware extracts a set of files and installs an encryption service. The ransomware program restarts the system about two minutes after installation of DiskCryptor to complete driver installation.

actions.name: saved encryption key and shutdown time to configuration file
actions.description: The encryption key and the shutdown time variable are saved to the configuration file (myConf.txt) and is readable until the second restart about two hours later which concludes the encryption and displays the ransom note.

actions.name: displayed ransom note after second reboot
actions.description: The system displays a ransom note including the actor’s email address, ransomware file name, the host system name, and a place to enter the decryption key after the second restart which concludes the encryption.
